title: GuppyLM: A ~9M parameter LLM that talks like a small fish
description:
GuppyLM is a 9-million parameter language model built from scratch that does exactly one thing: pretends to be a small fish named Guppy. No SwiGLU, no RoPE. Just a pure vanilla 6-layer transformer. Trains in 5 minutes on a free Colab T4 GPU.The entire pipeline is exposed: data generation, BPE tokenizer training, architecture, training loop, inference.Ask it the meaning of life. It says "food. the answer is always food."

https://github.com/arman-bd/guppylm
